compiled_state.title: As a CI maintainer, I can configure the CI review provider via dso-config.conf and the runner consults a single helper script for all LLM calls
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: A new helper script `plugins/dso/scripts/llm-api-call.sh` that all CI LLM call sites delegate to, plus a provider-agnostic CI config namespace.
**Why**: Establishes the foundation for swapping LLM providers in CI without touching the runner; all downstream Phase 2 work depends on this contract being right.
**Scope**:
- IN: Helper script with documented interface and request/response normalization for both providers; new config keys in dso-config.reference.conf; documentation in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md; tests covering both providers with mocked curl
- OUT: Refactoring ci-llm-review-runner.sh (P2-S2); modifying ci.yml workflow (P2-S3); changing local-environment Anthropic-pinned keys (out of epic scope)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `plugins/dso/scripts/llm-api-call.sh` exists with the documented interface `(system-prompt-file, user-message, tier, [config-file])`, branches on `model.provider`, and normalizes Anthropic `{content:[{text:...}]}` and OpenAI `{choices:[{message:{content:...}}]}` envelopes to a single output shape on stdout
  ← Satisfies: "Provider-abstraction helper script ships with tests"
- When this story is complete, the helper constructs provider-appropriate auth headers — Anthropic uses `x-api-key` + `anthropic-version`; OpenAI uses `Authorization: Bearer` — and reads `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` when provider=anthropic and `OPENAI_API_KEY` when provider=openai (presence of the wrong-provider key is not a substitute); tests assert the correct header set is sent for each provider via captured curl args
  ← Satisfies: "Provider-abstraction helper script ships with tests"
- When this story is complete, the helper documents which OpenAI endpoint it uses (Chat Completions `/v1/chat/completions` or Responses `/v1/responses`) and the parameter mapping from Anthropic-shaped inputs (system-prompt-file, user-message, max_tokens, temperature) to the OpenAI request body — including system-prompt placement (system role vs. instructions field), max_tokens vs. max_completion_tokens vs. max_output_tokens naming, and any reasoning/verbosity parameters required by the gpt-5.x family; tests fixture both providers' actual request bodies, not only response envelopes
  ← Satisfies: "Provider-abstraction helper script ships with tests"
- When this story is complete, the helper requests JSON output from each provider using the provider's native mechanism — Anthropic via prompt convention; OpenAI via `response_format={type:json_object}` or `json_schema` for structured outputs — and documents whether the reviewer-findings JSON schema is enforced server-side (OpenAI structured outputs) or client-side only; tests assert that prose-wrapped JSON (e.g., markdown fences) is normalized or rejected consistently across providers
  ← Satisfies: "Provider-abstraction helper script ships with tests"
- When this story is complete, `tests/scripts/test-llm-api-call.sh` covers both providers with mocked curl, verifies envelope normalization, and asserts that a misconfigured-model 4xx surfaces a single stderr line containing the provider name, tier name, offending model ID, and the provider's error text, with a non-zero exit code
  ← Satisfies: "Misconfigured model ID surfaces actionable error" + "Provider-abstraction helper script ships with tests"
- When this story is complete, `plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf` defines `model.provider`, `model.light`, `model.standard`, `model.deep` with documented defaults — Anthropic: `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` / `claude-sonnet-4-6` / `claude-opus-4-7`; OpenAI: `gpt-5.4-nano` / `gpt-5.4` / `gpt-5.5` — and `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` adds four new key sections with valid-value lists (anthropic|openai), per-provider examples, and explicit defaults
  ← Satisfies: "CI config namespace defined and documented"
- unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Testing] Mocked curl responses must cover both Anthropic and OpenAI envelopes including the 4xx error path; test fixtures should capture actual request bodies sent, not only assert response handling
- [Reliability] Helper must fail-closed when the API key matching the configured provider is unset — wrong-provider key presence does not substitute
- [Reliability] Anthropic and OpenAI surface rate-limit/overload conditions with different status codes, headers (`retry-after` vs `x-ratelimit-reset-*`), and JSON error shapes; helper must either implement a unified retry/backoff layer with provider-specific parsing of retry-after, OR explicitly do no retries and document that the caller is responsible — choice owned by this story because P2-S2's deep tier fires 4 calls per review

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
